pages.text: If you die with the Spirit Instincts enabled, a black smoke will appear at the location of your death, preserving all your items along with their positions.$(br2)Right-click the smoke: your items will return to their original positions, and if the position is occupied, they will be shifted.
Only one Soul Shard can exist at a time (the quantity is configured). A new death will remove the previous one. Only the owner can retrieve the items.
